channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Troy Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Troy Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Austin Reaves on Troy Brown
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Austin Reaves on Troy Brown Jr:

“I don't think he gets the credit that he deserves, honestly.... Always usually chasing around the team's best player. Rebounds the ball well, and then the confidence shooting the ball. He's a very, very capable shooter and shoots it well.”

Austin Reaves on Troy Brown, Mar 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Tommy Sheppard on Moritz Wagner, Troy Brown
item.description:
Fred Katz:Wizards GM Tommy Sheppard:

“Unfortunately, when you acquire players, it means other players have to leave. I can’t say enough great things about Troy Brown and Moe Wagner.”

Tommy Sheppard on Moritz Wagner, Troy Brown, Mar 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Scott Brooks on Ron Baker, Troy Brown
item.description:
Scott Brooks on if Troy Brown could get more minutes considering 3 OTs last night:

“Maybe some other guys getting more minutes. Troy has to be ready. Chase, maybe. Ron Baker. These guys are all new guys, but they play hard. I don't have to worry about them not playing hard.”

Scott Brooks on Ron Baker, Troy Brown, Dec 23, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Ernie Grunfeld on Troy Brown
item.description:
Grunfeld on the prospect of Troy Brown cracking the rotation:

“That’s going to be up to him. We have a veteran team here… but the opportunity is always there & if he earns it, he’ll play. Hopefully as the season progresses, he’ll get better and better & he’ll get some minutes.”

Ernie Grunfeld on Troy Brown, Jun 21, 2018. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.
